goal: The legacy editor is retired stage by stage: retained originals render without it, profiles are the ordinary launch, a new profile starts on Paper, and the legacy write paths go.
scope: R1: retained originals and read-only copies render without the editor
R3: a new profile starts with its managed runtime on, so New page is a Paper
R2: profiles mode is the ordinary launch; an old library is adopted into a profile
R4: the legacy write paths and the Tiptap editor leave the app
acceptance: A retained original shows its text with no editing surface, links open, history reads
A new profile on an installation that knows a runtime, or an application that carries one, runs its runtime with no setup
An ordinary launch opens profiles; a legacy library found at launch is adopted, never lost
After R4 no code path writes the legacy store; rollback, retained originals and adoption still work; the Tiptap packages are gone
nextAction: Closed. Next cycle: resume C086 (licences of what the application carries, a Mac without developer tools, size) until the Windows machine is back (about 2026-10-05); then C085's Windows exits and the real-library review that closes P2.
truthReview: 2026-10-01: R1 to R4 delivered on macOS. No code path in the app writes the legacy store; the legacy tab is read-only; the Tiptap packages are gone from the app and its lockfile. Unit suite 684 cases green; the legacy journey (76 steps), the switch, launch and preparation tours pass at the R4 commit. Not chased: the writer-fence tour outside the suite predates the preparation gate and expects a writer refusal where the gate now answers first. The provider truth runner's successful-edit scenarios wait for a Paper runtime. No Windows run; the real-library review is still owed to P2.
screenshotReview: Visual run 2026-09-30T21-20-32-970Z approved: 46 entries pixel-identical, the legacy document tour now rendered without the editor. The adoption offer, the adopted profile and the read-only original were inspected in the live rehearsal screenshots.
